text: The Dark Heart of the Mogu is an exploration achievement earned for discovering each of the lore objects in Pandaria that tell the tale of the mogu. *Valley of the Emperors Tomb of Conquerors, Kun-Lai Summit *The Lost Dynasty Pools of Youth, Krasarang Wilds *Spirit Binders Terrace of Ten Thunders, Jade Forest *The Thunder King east ridge above Mistfall Village, Vale of Eternal Blossoms Upon interaction with the fourth lore object, adventurers will immediately gain 2000 reputation with the Lorewalkers, and sends a letter via the in-game mail system: Attached is The Dark Heart of the Mogu (item), which begins a quest, The Dark Heart of the Mogu (quest).

The Curse and the Silence is a lore object found at in the clearing of the northwestern exit of the Lightning Vein Mine on the northwestern side of the Isle of Thunder. It tells a tale of the time of the mogu before and after the Curse of Flesh. Interacting with the lore object is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Gods and Monsters.

The Crumble Bundle is a quest achievement earned for picking up and completing the fetch-quest The Crumbled Chamberlain within 10 minutes after accepting it. See the quest article for more information. This achievement is required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker.

The Dark Prophet Zul is a lore object located at in the pen with the Defiant Devilsaur in the Beast Pens on the northwestern side of the Isle of Thunder. Interacting with the lore object is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Zandalari Prophecy.

The Crown of Heaven is offered by Wrathion part way through the Patch 5.2 portion of his legendary quest. To get to this point, champions must have completed the Patch 5.0 and Patch 5.1 portions of Wrathion's quest, Breath of the Black Prince (quest) and Call of the Packmaster / The Soul of the Horde respectively, acquired twenty Secrets of the Empire from raid bosses in the Throne of Thunder (alongside 40 Trillium Bars), reached standing with him by killing mogu, saurok, Zandalari troll, and opposing faction players on the Isle of Thunder, unlocked the Thunder Forge, and killed the world boss Nalak. Once all of those trials have been accomplished, Wrathion will award a selection of legendar
The Dark Prowler is a rare lion located to the southwest of the Sludgeguard Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Dark Portal is the cinematic intro for World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade.
The Deep Tunneler is a level 53 rare worm located at the back of the Mazthoril cave in Winterspring.

The The Crystal Blade of Torvath is found at at the south end of the Shimmer Moor in southeast . Interact with it: : :"Here Vindicator Torvath fell in battle to end the rage of the ancients. :May the light shine upon this grove that he so valiantly defended to protect and may it forever bring peace upon its denizens." : : A Silverleaf Ancient from the south starts walking toward the player and attacks! : This one walks in from the north. : The final ancient attacks from the east. Once the last ancient is dead, loot the Crystal Blade of Torvath from the stone.
Were you looking for: *The comic, see Descent *The subzone in Siege of Orgrimmar, see Descent (Siege of Orgrimmar) *The subzone in Tanaan Jungle, see Descent (Tanaan Jungle)
The Cryptic Tome of Tailoring starts the profession quest line for tailors to unlock 700 skill and the Tailoring Emporium for your garrison.
There are three quests that share this name: * The Dark Riders (death knight) * The Dark Riders (druid) * The Dark Riders (warlock)
the Death Stalker is a title awarded upon completing the Garrison achievement Nemesis: Death Stalker. The title appears after your character's name: :, the Death Stalker
The Cypher of Broken Bone unlocks Bonebreaker appearance for The Kingslayers artifact.
The Day the Horde Came was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion. However, it was removed prior to release.

.]] The Deathbringer is a Forsaken battleship located in Ashil's Bay in Stormheim, on the Broken Isles. A member of the large fleet dispatched to the Broken Isles by Banshee Queen Sylvanas Windrunner, the Deathbringer was assigned to the Forsaken expedition in the vrykul-dominated region of Stormheim. Along with the Oblivion, it is responsible for spearheading Sylvanas's operations in and around the stronghold of Dreadwake's Landing, as she pursues her mysterious objective. The ship possesses a full complement of catapults, as well as stores of the infamous Forsaken New Plague, and is commanded by Dread-Captain Graham.
The Darkest Crusade is an Unholy death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Eternal Agony (artifact trait), Portal to the Underworld and Scourge of Worlds traits.
The Dalaran Fountain continues the short quest chain to acquire the fishing artifact, the Underlight Angler.
The Cow King is a tauren mini-boss that regularly spawns in the "Secret Cow Level", a special phased version of the Yorgen Farmstead in Duskwood available during Diablo's 20th Anniversary.
the Darkener is a title rewarded from Mythic: Kil'jaeden. The title will show after the character's name, in the following format: : the Darkener
The Demon Within manifests when the spirit of Sargeras tries to take control of Illidan Stormrage's body during the Gul'dan encounter in the Nighthold.
The Cursed Shard was a breadcrumb quest to have players learn about how to upgrade their Legion legendary gear to item level 1000 using :Awoken Titan Essence.
The Crimson Harvest is a submarine located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Dealmaker is a submarine located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Dark Call was a submarine of the Iron Horde. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
The Crybaby Hozen is an elite hozen in the Scrollkeeper's Sanctum of the Temple of the Jade Serpent. It is a creature from pandaren literature brought to life by Haunting Sha.
The Dark Heart of Nazmir is a quest achievement earned for completing the Nazmir storyline.
The Dark Below is sold by Master Talekeeps in the following dive bars for :
The Cycle of Life is a world quest offered by Scrollsage Nola at each of the six zones of Kul Tiras and Zandalar.

The Cursed Old Wolf is a Scarlet Brotherhood propaganda pamphlet located in a stand of trees just southwest of Calston Estate in Tirisfal Glades. Three other similar pamphlets are lying in the same location: The Last Menethil, The Traitor King (item), and The Would-Be Queen. Looting it requires level .

The Curse of Stone is a book looted from the Corrupted Chest after defeating Alleria Windrunner in the Vision of Stormwind or Thrall in the Vision of Orgrimmar. Written by a cultist, it was meant to serve as anti-Titan propaganda; it aims to document the "lies of the Titans" and the "injustice" they inflicted upon the denizens of Azeroth. Its name is a twist on the term "the Curse of Flesh."
The Crucible of Flame is an Azerite Essence obtained through the quests to unlock the Heart Forge.
The Craw is a crane that appears in the Garden of Night in Ardenweald during the world quest To Serve Spriggan.
The Dark Bastille is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating all bosses in the wings of the Sanctum of Domination.
The Deceiver's Grand Design drops from Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
The Crone's Shirt was never made available, but likely belongs to The Crone.
The Crown of Wills concludes "Crown of Wills", the namesake fifth chapter of the Zereth Mortis campaign. The next chapter, "A Means to an End", begins with Something Wonderful.

The Death March: An Introduction to Maldraxxi Etiquette can be looted from the following Ember Court chests: *Grandmaster Vole's Extravagant Tribute *Plague Deviser Marileth's Extravagant Tribute *Alexandros Mograine's Extravagant Tribute *Baroness Vashj's Extravagant Tribute

__NOTOC__ The Culler is a devourer controller that spawns in the Cradle of Nascence in Zereth Mortis during A Mysterious Voice. Immediately upon entering the Cradle, it harvests the energy of the two Automa Defenders, killing them and turning it into a mutated version of itself.

The Deed to Andorhal can be found at on the eastern wall of the main room of the town hall of Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands. Return it to Magistrate Marduke in return for an Authentic Andorhal Candle as part of the Memory of Scholomance.
The Couture Collection was a bundle of 4 transmog sets and 1 toy, available at a discounted price, the bundle was available from 20 June 2023 to 4 July 2023.

The Emerald Dreamcatcher is an Alliance only quest in Teldrassil, the night elf starting zone. In this quest, players are sent by Tallonkai Swiftroot to Starbreeze Village to find his missing dreamcatcher.
__NOTOC__ The Dragon's Eye is a quality Necklace that improves Intellect, Stamina and Versatility.

The Duke of Cynders is a flamewaker, and one of the Elemental Nobles of the Abyssal Council. The Cenarion Circle believe that he and the other three Dukes are the primary force behind the organization of the Twilight's Hammer Cultists in Silithus.
__NOTOC__ The End of Dreams is a one-handed mace, primarily for Druids.

__NOTOC__ The Duke of Fathoms is a hydra, and one of the Elemental Nobles of the Abyssal Council. The Cenarion Circle believe that he and the other three Dukes are the primary force behind the organization of the Twilight's Hammer Cultists in Silithus. The Duke of Fathoms does not appear normally in the standard plane of existence but must be summoned. There are two ways of summoning the Duke: #Acquire a set of Twilight Trappings and a Twilight Cultist Medallion of Station. This will make you appear to be a middle-ranked leader of the Twilight's Hammer. Travel to a Wind stone and use it to summon a Duke. You have a 1 in 4 chance of summoning the Duke of Fathoms. #Turn in Encrypted Twilight T
The Divination Scryer starts the Scryer segment of the quest chain.

__NOTOC__ The Duke of Zephyrs is a wind serpent, and one of the Elemental Nobles of the Abyssal Council. The Cenarion Circle believe that he and and the other three Dukes are the primary force behind the organization of the Twilight's Hammer Cultists in Silithus. Its relations with Anshal and Asaad are unknown.
The Emperor's New Cape is a Level 51 quality Cloak that improves Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.
The Emitter is an Alliance-only quest in the draenei starting area, Ammen Vale. This quest is only available after a chain which starts with Inoculation from Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site.
The Dreamer's Shoulderpads are a world drop from Outland mobs.
The Ethereum is the first part of a Netherstorm-based quest chain that ends with Nexus-King Salhadaar.

The Emperor's Tomb is an ancient tablet on which a poem is inscribed, warning of the dangers of the emperor's tomb. It is located in the north western part of the Ruins of Zul'Kunda. There are some back ways to get in, by climbing up the hills to the east of the ruins and running along the ledge there. However, you can also get in the normal way by coming from the east or west (beach)entrances and going up the ramp. Be careful because there is a lvl 41 elite in this area. The tablet can be found near the pool of water in the north eastern part of this "room". Coordinates: (24,09) The Alliance has recently expressed interest in this particular legend. Brother Nimetz of the Rebel Camp in Stran
The Eighteenth Pilot is a neutral quest in the quest chain in which players are asked to speak with the goblin pilot, Razzeric.
The Druids Arise is Chapter 4 of the Night Elf campaign, Eternity's End.
:Soft and perfectly snackable, these golden pretzels are best enjoyed in the autumn with cheese and booze! If you're wandering the Brewfest grounds, you've simply got to try the pretzels!
The Enemy Revealed is the 12th installment of the World of Warcraft comic.

The Diary of High General Abbendis is the updated version of the book The Path of Redemption. It is lying on a beside table on the top floor of High General Abbendis' house in New Hearthglen in the Dragonblight. The text is identical to that of the updated The Path of Redemption (Updated version) from the corresponding Alliance quest.
The Etymidian is a quest in the Waygate quest chain in Sholazar Basin.

The Ebon Watcher is the identity taken by Highlord Darion Mograine, master of the Knights of the Ebon Blade, while he is in Northrend. He can be found initially at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown discussing tactics with Tirion Fordring; after completing The Last Line Of Defense, he moves to an area in the Valley of Echoes near the Light's Breach. After Crusaders' Pinnacle is claimed by the Argent Crusade, the Watcher is gone, though Darion — out of his disguise — appears on at least two occasions in Icecrown: During The Air Stands Still, summoned by the player to fight Underking Talonox in Scourgeholme, and again in the Cathedral of Darkness in Tirion's Gambit, accompanied by Thassarian, Kol
The Destruction of Stratholme is the tenth mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
.]] The Dreadlords Convene is the first interlude in the Undead campaign, Path of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ This achievement rewards the title The Diplomat. It was introduced in Patch 3.0.2 as part of the Achievement System. To get the title you must be exalted with Timbermaw Hold, Sporeggar, and Kurenai. The title is formatted like this: : the Diplomat
The Dominion of Lordaeron was a book written by the orc Utok Scratcher. His experiences during the Second War are recorded in it.
The Empire of Zul'Drak is a quest achievement earned by completing Zul'Drak quests in Zul'Drak.
The Escape From Durnholde is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Old Hillsbrad Foothills instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
The Doctor's Cleaver can be found in the Sanctum of Reanimation in Icecrown, on a table in the back .
The Dusts of Outland is an interlude in the campaign Curse of the Blood Elves.
The Durnholde Challenge is provided for the quest The Durnholde Challenge: Zephyrus.
The Earthinator's Cudgel drops from at the Fractured Battlefront in Deepholm.
The Elementium Axe drops from Blindeye the Guardian in the Twilight Highlands.
The Earthen Ring is an achievement gained by getting with the Earthen Ring in Vashj'ir.

"The Emperor's Burden - Part 5" is part of a series of in-game books called The Emperor's Burden. It can be found as a wood-panel scroll leaning against a bell shrine, at on the upper terrace of Niuzao Temple, off the western coast of Townlong Steppes. Interacting with the scroll is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.
The Emperor's Burden are a series of in-game books relating to the The Seven Burdens of Shaohao exploration achievement. They tell the tale of Shaohao, the Last Emperor of Pandaria.

"The Emperor's Burden - Part 2" is part of a series of in-game books called The Emperor's Burden. This wood-panel scroll can be found at behind , leaning against a tree at Seeker's Point, halfway up Mount Neverest in central Kun-Lai Summit. Interacting with the scroll is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.

"The Emperor's Burden - Part 3" is part of a series of in-game books called The Emperor's Burden. The shrine can be found at to the left of the instance line of the Temple of the Jade Serpent on the Jade Temple Grounds. Interacting with the pandaren lore object is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.

"The Emperor's Burden - Part 4" is part of a series of in-game books called The Emperor's Burden. The shrine is located at on the landing where the stairs reach the second floor of the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang Wilds. Interacting with the shrine is an objective of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.

"The Emperor's Burden - Part 6" is part of a series of in-game books called The Emperor's Burden. It can be found as a wood-panel scroll leaning against a bell shrine at in front of the main building of the Temple of the White Tiger in northeastern Kun-Lai Summit. Interacting with the scroll is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.

"The Emperor's Burden - Part 7" is part of a series of in-game books called The Emperor's Burden. It can be found as a wood-panel scroll leaning against a bell shrine, southeast of the main entrance to the Shado-Pan Monastery at in the big gazebo. Interacting with The Emperor's Burden - Part 7 is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.
The Doctor Is In was a guild perk that increases the healing bonus from bandages. This perk, gained at guild level 10, replaced Chug-A-Lug.

The Emperor's Burden - Part 8 is an in-game book, part of The Emperor's Burden. It can be found at in the Summer Fields of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Interacting with the pandaren lore object is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.

The Empress is a wood-panel scroll at the base of a statue located at , north of the Heart of Fear in the Dread Wastes. Interacting with the scroll is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Heart of the Mantid Swarm.
The Dungeons of Dojan can be found at the Incursion in the Krasarang Wilds. It is translated by Lorekeeper Vaeldrin.
The Dragon Scrolls of Kalimdor are found in the Fortuitous Coffer.
The Dreadshredder is a robot built by Megs Dreadshredder, located at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

The Egg of Varasha is found at at the western end of the Writhing Mire in northwestern Spires of Arak. Find the mouth of the cave at inland to the east, and head in to find Varasha's Egg in a nest bathed in a column of light. Inspect the egg: :This looks to be a hydra egg and is very close to hatching. :Its mother would likely be nearby and would not appreciate you being near her nest. : : Varasha, a level 97 rare elite hydra charges in. Defeat her and loot Varasha's Egg to pick up the Hydraling, a combat pet.
The Draenor Gourmet is an achievement requiring the player to cook any 20 of the 22 listed Draenor Cooking recipes.
World of Warcraft: The Essential Sunwell Collection is a compilation of the Sunwell Trilogy and the Trag saga.
The Everbloom: Bronze is an achievement earned from completing The Everbloom challenge mode with a Bronze rating or better.
The Everbloom: Silver is an achievement earned from completing The Everbloom Challenge Mode with a rating of Silver or better.
The Everbloom: Gold is an achievement earned from completing The Everbloom Challenge Mode with a Gold rating.
"The Eredar Destiny" is a book found in Socrethar's Rise in . Reading it is a part of the The Word of Socrethar. It was written by the eredar , leader of the Sargerei.
the Dwarfstalker is a title awarded upon completing the Garrison achievement Nemesis: Dwarfstalker. The title appears after your character's name: : the Dwarfstalker
The Dragonslayers unlocks the Dragonslayer's Edge appearance for the Warswords of the Valarjar artifact.
The Edict of Fire drops from Xioliang at Guo-Lai Halls in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The Edict of Stone drops from Zhu of the Eternal Stone at Guo-Lai Halls in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The Edict of the Storm drops from Thunder Serpent Nalak'Ra at Guo-Lai Halls in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The Edge of Dark and Light is a Discipline priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Darkest Shadows, Burst of Light, Borrowed Time (priest artifact trait) and Speed of the Pious traits.
The Eternal Dream is a Legion quest achievement rewarded for completing the Druid Campaign.
The Elemental Lords is a Legion quest achievement rewarded for completing the Shaman Campaign.

The Dwarven Dream is an archaeology achievement earned from completing The Relic Renewed. Once Crystalline Eye of Undravius, Imp Generator, Wyrmy Tunkins, Blood of Young Mannoroth, and Purple Hills of Eredath have been acquired, Brann offers the quest.

The Dreadsoul is a Legion ship in the Twisting Nether accessed through the Hijacked Portal captured by Tehd Shoemaker and Marius Felbane during Where There is a Whip... and How Do YOU Like It?!. Cazarian Skornbringers and Dreadsoul Wrathguards work aboard the ship, with Paal the Cazarian likely spearheading operations.
__NOTOC__ The Dread Stalker is a felbat located in the Sunken Stair in the Tomb of Sargeras.
The Doom of Azeroth is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Sharpened Dreadfangs and Summoner's Prowess traits.

set out from Booty Bay]] The Dreadwake is a promotional pirate ship mount offered in celebration of 2018, that started on 19 September 2018. True to nautical tradition, the Dreadwake pirate ship mount has a unique figurehead inspired by an unknown kraken-faced god of the deeps. It's the perfect way to cruise through Azeroth in true buccaneering style.
The Eight Wonders of Azeroth is a book found in Gorm's Den in Nazjatar.
The Drowned Oracles is a world quest at Elun'alor Temple in Nazjatar. The area is under the effect of the debuff.
The Emerald Nightmare Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raids achievement earned by defeating the bosses of The Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher, while in a guild group.
The Eternal Palace Guild Run is a guild dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the bosses The Eternal Palace on Normal difficulty or higher, while in a guild group.
The Even More Horrific Vision of Stormwind is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in the Horrific Vision of Stormwind in a single visit.
The Even More Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all objectives in the Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar in a single visit.
The Dirty Five is an expansion feature achievement earned by raising 5 War Campaign Champions to Epic Level.

The End of the Beginning starts the "The Endless Dark" chapter of the Shadowlands campaign. To reach this point, players must have completed all four of the level-up campaigns (including the Revendreth storyline) and have reached level .
The Enchanted Dragon is obtained from Greed's Reward in Revendreth. It will lay a Golden Egg when used.
The Endmire's Mists is looted from Bleakwood Chests in Revendreth.
The Ever-Rising Tide is an Azerite Essence obtained through the reputation factions in Nazjatar. This essence can only be used by healer specializations.
The Emerald Turtle is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

In the area are some other doodads, including a painter's easel, a sword, Horde shield, shovel, and a few candles. The Dreadful Blend is a potential quest for the Kyrian Assault on Cocyrus and Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw.
The Devouring Cold drops from Kel'Thuzad, the penultimate boss encounter in the Sanctum of Domination.
__NOTOC__ The Enlightened is a reputation achievement earned by reaching exalted status with the Enlightened.

.]] The Dragon Pack was a bundle of five mounts and two companions that are available at a discount from the Battle.net Shop and the In-Game Store. The bundle was available from 16 December 2021 to 3 January 2022, and then again from 18 to 31 October 2022.
__NOTOC__ The Engulfer is a devourer located in the Genesis Fields in Zereth Mortis. It will appear after The Matriarch has been helped defeating enough waves of devourers.
The Disgruntled Hunter is a reputation achievement earned by finding the disgruntled hunter near every Grand Hunt.
The Djaradin Have Awoken concludes the first chapter of the Waking Shores storyline. Chapter two begins with Reporting for Duty.
The Devilsaur's Bite is a quest reward from Life Finds a Way.

The Elder's Drawing is provided by Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor on the southern shore of Dragonblight after showing him Shomko's Unyielding Spear, part of the first day of Secrets of Azeroth. He says:
The Emerald Bounty is an exploration achievement earned by contributing 10 seeds to the Emerald Bounty.
The Feast of Winter Veil is a book that summarizes the legends surrounding the Feast of Winter Veil seasonal event.
The Exorcism is the 3rd quest in the Return to the Marsh quest chain.
The Face of Death is an excellent epic shield for tanks. Prior to the release of The Burning Crusade expansion it was the best tanking shield in the game. Graphically resembles The Hungering Cold.
The Eye of Nerub is a polearm seemingly made for Hunters, having a large amount of Agility and increasing skill level with all types of ranged weapons.
The Eye of Hakkar is a necklace suitable for rogues, DPS warriors and hunters.
The Fall of Kel'Thuzad is a quest which begins from The Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad, dropped by Kel'Thuzad in Naxxramas.

The Eye of Shadow dropped from: *Dreadlord in Blasted Lands *Hederine Slayer in Winterspring *Hederine Initiate in Winterspring *Manahound in Blasted Lands *Felguard Elite in Blasted Lands *Doomguard Commander in Blasted Lands Prior to his migration in The Burning Crusade, Lord Kazzak dropped this as well.
The Eye of Divinity can be found inside the Cache of the Firelord.
The Fel Barrier is an epic tanking shield with fire and shadow resistance bonuses.
In The Fate of Yenniku, the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok finally reveal the whereabouts of Yenniku, the Darkspear chief's son.

The Eye of Haramad is used to open the Stasis Chamber of Nexus-Prince Shaffar and summon the void hound Yor in the Mana-Tombs of Auchindoun. Yor can only be summoned if the instance is being run on Heroic.

This quest is the entry to the The Farstrider Enclave quest chain. It is technically not a requirement to start the chain, but you cannot take this quest once you started the second quest.
The First Troll Legend is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest Kurzen's Mystery.
This quest concludes the Learning from the Crystals quest chain.
__NOTOC__ The Exobar, also known as the Caregiver Center is now the local inn for travelers visiting the Exodar, with Caregiver Breel watching over them.
The Fists of Fury are a pair of fist weapons. Their look is matching Shaman Tier 5 armor set.

The Facemelter was announced on April 1st 2008 as a sample item for the newly announced hero class for Wrath of the Lich King, bard. This item is not available in game and it is doubtful that it ever will be.
The Eye of Dalaran is the eleventh mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.
The Fire Extinguisher is a quest reward from This Just In: Fire Still Hot!.
The Fall of Lordaeron is the fourteenth and final mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
The Fall of Stromgarde is the seventh mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
This breadcrumb is offered by Brann after completing Norgannon's Shell.
the Exalted is a title awarded from completing 40 Exalted Reputations. The title will show after the character's name, in the following format: : the Exalted
The Flame Keeper is a meta achievement related to the seasonal world event called the Midsummer Fire Festival. Upon completion you will receive the title .
The Flame Warden is a meta achievement related to the seasonal world event called the Midsummer Fire Festival. Upon completion you will receive the title .

The Fires of Azeroth is a meta achievement for completing all instances of the (Horde) Honor the Flame quests, as shown by completing all of the Flame Keeper achievements. Completing this achievement is an objective of the meta achievement The Flame Keeper.

The Fleshshaper drops from Sjonnir The Ironshaper in Halls of Stone on heroic mode. The Flashshaper ended up in the hands of the adventurers, who Sjonnir thought so fragile, when they defeated him during their assault of Ulduar.

The Flag of Ownership was first introduced as a World of Warcraft TCG card. The card has a code that can be turned in in-game to Landro Longshot in Booty Bay for the item. With the TCG no longer being produced, the card itself can only be purchased from websites that sell such cards, or specialty vendors that might still have the appropriate booster packs that this card was produced with. It can be listed on the Black Market Auction House by Landro Longshot, for the opening bid of .
The Flesh of "Two Huge Pincers" is looted from Kili'ua on Kili'ua's Atoll in the Dragonblight.
The Fall of Naxxramas (10 player) is an account-wide meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating every boss in Naxxramas on 10-player mode.
In order to be eligible for this quest, players are required to have been awarded the title .

The Fires Down Below is chapter 4 of the Exodus of the Horde campaign. Thrall, finding himself a prisoner of the murlocs in a cavern, combines forces with jungle trolls to escape. During their escape, Sen'jin was sacrificed by a Murloc Sorcerer and although it was killed the cave began to quake and the Horde had to escape.
The Faceroller is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for killing Eadric the Pure in the Trial of the Champion with his own hammer on Heroic difficulty.
The First Guardian is the third story in Warcraft: Legends Volume 5. *Written by Louise Simonson. *Art by Seung-hui Kye.
The Fishing Diplomat is an achievement gained by fishing any fish in both Orgrimmar and Stormwind.
The Facebreaker can be found inside the Tribute Chest after defeating Anub'arak in the 10-man version of Trial of the Grand Crusader.

The First Rule of Ring of Blood is You Don't Talk About Ring of Blood is a quest achievement earned for completing the Ring of Blood quests in Nagrand, Ampitheater of Anguish quests in Zul'Drak, and Crucible of Carnage questsin Twilight Highlands.

This quest is part of the Children's Week quests where you escort the orcish orphan Grunth. All of Ridin' the Rocketway, The Fallen Chieftain, and Strong New Allies must be completed to progress to the next pair of quests.
The Fallen Guardian is offered by Ysera inside the Nordrassil Inn.
The Fiery Lords of Sethria's Roost is a quest achievement earned for killing the minions of Ragnaros in Sethria's Roost. Requirement for the meta-achievement Veteran of the Molten Front.

The Fall of Shan Bu ends the fifth and final stage of the Isle of Thunder storyline, gaining access to the Foot of Lei Shen and the world boss Nalak. Lady Jaina Proudmoore will only offer this quest from her position on the Violet Rise once enough realm-wide progress has been made, irrespective of the individual player's standing with the Kirin Tor Offensive. Much like with the previous progression quest, A Bold Idea, this quest mostly takes place in a single-player scenario also called "The Fall of Shan Bu". As the scenario can only be completed once, it is documented here and not in a separate article.
The Few, the Proud, the Gob Squad is an achievement earned for completing the Secrets of Ragefire scenario without any member of the Gob Squad taking damage.

The Fall of Auchindoun is the sixth mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.

The Felblight is a river of fel sludge in Tanaan Jungle that was unleashed by , corrupting most parts of the jungle. It flows down from the pinnacle of the down to , where it forms a deadly moat around the fortress. To the west lies the Fel Forge. Standing in the Felblight's corrupted waters grants Fel Sludge for 30 minutes, a stacking debuff that increases damage dealt and taken by 5% per stack - and is immediately lethal at 10 stacks.
The Fist of Ra-den is one of the artifacts used by elemental shamans in World of Warcraft: Legion. Equipping it will automatically place The Highkeeper's Ward in your off hand.

The Fate of Aegwynn is a book by Historian Llore discussing Aegwynn. An excerpt from it details how Aegwynn confronted her corrupted son, Medivh, but how she only narrowly survived the encounter, and how she later retreated from society and entrusted :Aluneth to the Kirin Tor upon learning of her son's death.

The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald is a book written by Royal Historian Archesonus. The book's third chapter describes Arthas Menethil's return to Lordaeron and how he murdered his father, King Terenas, by plunging Frostmourne through his heart. During the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, this book was made available as an item. However, even though the book can still be acquired, the reason of its existence was removed prior to release.

The False Keeper is a book by Historian Llore. The book's third chapter describes how Volund declared himself warlord of Stormheim's vrykul after killing those who opposed him with :Titanstrike. Chapter seven describes how Volund gradually grew paranoid that his followers were planning to betray him and take Titanstrike for themselves, leading the warlord to torture and execute many of his allies, and, in turn, causing the bulk of his army to abandon him.
The First Satyr's Spaulders drop from Xavius in the Emerald Nightmare.

The First Rule of Dueler's Guild is a player vs. player achievement earned by participating in a duel in the Dueler's Guild.
The First Dance is an Azerite trait available to Subtlety rogues.

The Guardian was a revenant who warned Arthas to not draw the cursed sword Frostmourne from its pedestal, but Arthas did so regardless of the dire warning. The Guardian is described by Arthas as "the leader [of the group of revenants], the one assigned to guard Frostmourne" or as "the strange protector", and the other revenants "the other elemental guardians of the sword". Little information is given beyond that and the description of the battle. The only other hints to his motivations are the inscription on the dais being written in Kalimag, and the green ore in the walls of Frostmourne Cavern being referenced as "softly glowing turquoise crystals and veins of ore".
